end.summary:
Discussed different family sizes and who may be part of a family.
Identified ways family members care for one another, including food, medicine, and talking.
Discussed sharing household tasks such as cleaning and serving food.
Trisha repeatedly said children are too small to help; this was not corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised how families can differ and how everyone can share care and household work. Trisha described giving medicine, sitting with someone, cleaning, and serving food; they also said family members can divide tasks. Trisha mixed up personal tasks with helping the family and continued to think children cannot help, so this was not corrected by the end. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small shared task, such as putting away books or setting out plates, and talk about how it helps everyone.
